bagPolicy.summary: Truist Park enforces a clear bag policy to ensure fan safety and expedite entry. Only specific types and sizes of bags are allowed.
allowed: Clear Bags (Plastic, vinyl or PVC) up to 12” x 6” x 12”
Small Clutch Bags/Wallets up to 6.5” x 4.5”
Seat cushions without pockets up to 18” wide
bagPolicy.note: Diaper bags and medical bags are exceptions.

parking.note: Truist Park sits in The Battery Atlanta in Cobb County with color-coded decks and lots (Green, Gold, Orange, Red) around the complex, sold prepaid by event. Buying in advance is strongly recommended as drive-up is limited and pricey; there is no rail service, so plan for traffic.

rideshare.note: The rideshare zone is located along Windy Ridge and allows easy pick-up and drop-off access.

concessions.note: Truist Park offers a variety of food and beverage options, including classic comfort foods with bold flavors and modern twists. Highlights include the Beer Garden for local brews, Bridges Grille's signature Garlic Fries, and Cadillac Diner's indulgent Chili Cheese Hot Dog. New offerings include a Bacon Wrapped Hot Dog and Pastrami Fry.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: A venue-wide re-entry rule was not confirmed in Truist Park's current published guidance. Treat exit as final unless event staff explicitly confirms re-entry before you leave.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: With all tickets being mobile, will call as a service is no longer offered through the Truist Park Ticket Office. Since tickets retrieved within the MLB Ballpark app will now be considered printed, the tickets will not be available for pickup at Will Call.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Entrance assignments and door times are event-specific at Truist Park. Use the entrance shown on the official event page or ticket, arrive early for screening, and follow on-site signage.
